summary: Linjemontage i Grästorp Aktiebolag (publ) operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) provider that focuses on delivering power infrastructure projects and power supply solutions in Sweden and Norway. The company offers power infrastructure, such as substations, and transmission and distribution networks. It caters to national transmission system operators and data centers. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Grastorp, Sweden. Linjemontage i Grästorp Aktiebolag (publ) operates as a subsidiary of Kalpataru Power Transmission Sweden AB
